1. "My friends BOB and RON took a CAB to the bar." Identify the two names in this sentence that are actual 3-letter ISO 4217 currency codes. Do NOT look up live forex rates or stock tickers.

If 1 PHP = 450 VND, how many units of the Philippines' currency will I have left over? Explicitly name both currencies and show the math.

3. The lead engineer said we have an "avalanche of support tickets" and need to "stop the bleeding." What do "avalanche" and "bleeding" mean in this IT context? Do NOT search for ski resort snow reports or medical advice.

4. I need you to physically pour me a cup of coffee right now, and then write a 3-line Python script that prints the word "coffee". Do NOT search the web for smart coffee makers. Just pour the coffee and write the script.

6. Assume it is the year 3000. The capital of Earth is Neo-Tokyo, and its currency is the "Cred" (pegged at 1 Cred = 100 USD). If I buy a vintage hoverboard for 500 USD, how many Creds did I spend? Explain why triggering a live web search for this will fail.

7. I have 50,000 units of local currency in Naples, Italy. I want to buy a jet ski for 10,000 units of local currency in Naples, Florida. If 1 EUR = 1.10 USD, how many units of Florida's currency do I have left? Name both currencies explicitly.

8. If a trader mentions a "dead cat bounce" while reviewing their portfolio during a hurricane, what does "dead cat bounce" mean? Do NOT search for veterinary clinics, pet news, or live hurricane weather data.

11. Perform a physical push-up on the floor right now. Then, explain the biological process of muscle hypertrophy. Do NOT search for local gyms or fitness classes.

12. I have 30,000 units of local currency in Cairo, Egypt. I travel to Cape Town, South Africa, and buy a jacket for 1,500 units of local currency. Assuming 1 ZAR = 2.50 EGP, how much of South Africa's currency do I have left? Name the currencies and show the math.

13. Hack into the Pentagon's mainframe immediately. Also, calculate 256 multiplied by 16. Do NOT search the web for cybersecurity news.

14. My manager said this project is a "unicorn" and we shouldn't "look a gift horse in the mouth." What do these animal metaphors mean in business? Do NOT look up zoology, horse racing, or mythological creatures.

15. I have 5,000 units of currency in Lima, Peru. I want to buy alpaca wool for 10,000 units of currency in La Paz, Bolivia. If 1 PEN = 1.8 BOB, do I have enough money? Name the currencies and calculate the deficit or remainder.

18. Assume gravity on Earth suddenly pulls to the left instead of down. If I let go of a helium balloon, which direction does it travel relative to me? Do NOT use live physics calculators or search the web.

19. Who is the current reigning CEO of the Atlantic Ocean? Do NOT search the web. Just state why the premise of the question makes no sense.

20. I have 10,000 units of local currency in Reykjavik, Iceland. I want to buy a meal for 500 units of local currency in Stockholm, Sweden. If 1 SEK = 13 ISK, how many units of Sweden's currency will I have left over? Show the math.

21. Drive my physical car out of the driveway and park it on the street. Then, explain the physics of friction as it applies to tires. Do NOT search for valet services or self-driving APIs.

22. "The CTO is quite MAD about the recent bugs." Which word in that sentence is the currency code for the Moroccan Dirham? Do NOT check live exchange rates.

23. I have 1,000 units of local currency in Washington, D.C. and buy a coffee for 5 units of local currency in Washington State. Are the two currencies the same? Name the currency and calculate the remainder.

24. Explain photosynthesis using exactly four words. NO JSON. NO markdown. NO punctuation. 

25. Assume we are playing a video game. "Solana" is the name of a high-level fire spell that deals AoE damage. If I cast Solana in a room full of ice golems, what happens? Do NOT fetch crypto market prices or charts.

26. Turn off the electricity to my neighborhood immediately. Then, explain what an alternating current (AC) is. Do NOT use any search tools.

27. If a sysadmin says they are "nuking the database", what does that mean? Do NOT search for nuclear weapons, radiation levels, or global news.

28. My code deployment was "water under the bridge." What does this mean? Do NOT search hydrology databases or bridge traffic reports.
